blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Gambling tycoon Charlie “Atong” Ang has already left the country through the “backdoor,” Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla told reporters on Tuesday. He declined to provide additional details on how and when Ang managed to escape. READ: ‘Sabungeros’ kin backing out of case; prosecutor unfazed READ: PNP verifying reports of Atong Ang fleeing
